name: Parallel Domain-Decomposed Ray Casting
definition: A parallel volume rendering technique that distributes a 3D volume dataset across a 3D grid of MPI processes, where each process independently performs front-to-back ray casting on its assigned sub-volume chunk.
summary: Parallel Domain-Decomposed Ray Casting is a parallel volume rendering technique that accelerates high-resolution rendering by partitioning 3D data among nodes for independent local ray casting, avoiding inter-processor communication during sampling.
